name: StartGame
note: ResetGame; start a 10 ms window animation; SetGameState(COUNTDOWN); ResumeGame. Registered in the CoffeeFactory constructor, never nil'd by its destructor, so the last constructed factory window (chocolate or coffee) owns the global. Lua: ui/coffee_factory.lua info dialog OK, ui/chocolate_gameover.lua Try again.

name: PauseGame
note: Pause: sets cursor cursor/cursor hotspot (1,1); if not already paused: pause sound, show child go, hide child pause, set paused, pause the four scaling tasks and the grid task, StopWindowAnimation, fill sibling window information from ui/game_pause.lua with Lua global gPauseText=text, show it. Always ends with TopModalOnly(false). Lua passes no argument (nil becomes empty string, game_pause.lua then falls back to the string key game_paused). C++ internal callers pass game_paused or coffee_first_missed.

name: ResumeGame
note: Sets cursor cursor/cursor hotspot (16,16). If paused: unpause sound, hide go, show pause, hide information, Restart(15) all five tasks (the argument is ignored by TScalingTask::Restart), restart 10 ms window animation, re-run SetGameState(current state) (in PLAYING this resets the grid task scale to 1 and its time to 0, and replays sound coffee_making_game), clear paused flag. Always ends with TopModalOnly(true).

name: GetScore
note: Returns the score field (this+0xf4): cases completed plus match bonuses. Called by ui/chocolate_gameover.lua.

name: RandomDesign
kind: native function (registered by RecipeDesigner ctor, nil on dtor)
note: See docs/re/ledger-and-game-natives.md 10.3. Delta: ticks at timer 100..1900; tint index sent to Lua is RandRange(1,100) which exceeds the 65-colour palette; SetRecipeTint wraps it.

name: SetRecipeType
note: Scans custom/<category>/ for layerN_MM.png (not _highlight); fills 4 per-layer lists; appends empty entry to layers 2-4 (non-beverage) or 2 and 4 (beverage). Details in ledger-and-game-natives.md 10.3.

name: SetLayer
note: index is absolute; stored index = (index + size) % size; returns it. Updates option_layerN/option_highlightN (scale 0.5) and display_layerN/display_highlightN (scale 1.0); hides when entry is empty or texture missing.

name: GetLayerImage
note: Current entry minus the first 7 characters (custom/). Empty entry gives empty string.

name: SetBackground
kind: native function (registered by SignEditor ctor, nil on dtor)
note: Loads logo/<name>, sets it as the Sign base sprite texture. Dereferences the Sign pointer without a null check.

name: SetLogo
note: Loads logo/<name> onto the Sign logo child sprite.

name: SetFont
note: TTextSprite::SetFont(fonts/<name>).

name: SetText
note: TTextSprite::SetText on the sign text sprite. Not the generic window SetText.

name: SetAnimScale
note: Dev curve editor: display scale; recentres background and sprite layer.

name: UpdateAnimTime
note: Reads TextEdit named time as an integer into pathTime; 0 becomes 1.

name: UpdateAnimLayer
note: Reads TextEdit named layer as an integer and applies TSprite::SetLayer to the preview sprite.

name: SetAnimSprite
note: Loads animated texture ports/animations/<name> onto the preview sprite and remembers the name.

name: CoffeeFactory
note: Class CoffeeFactory : TBSGWindow. See md section 1.

name: RecipeCreator
note: Empty TWindow subclass; Init, PostChildrenInit, Draw forward to TWindow; OnMouseMove and OnMouseDown return false. No Lua in either asset tree constructs it.

name: RecipeDesigner
note: TWindow subclass; no Init override (no DSL keys of its own); finds children by fixed names.

name: SignEditor
note: Sign designer; only ui/sign_basic.lua uses it and nothing opens that file.

name: CurveEditor
note: Dev tool (dev/dev_animation.lua). Class TCurveEditor.

name: warnOnMiss
note: Pause with text coffee_first_missed after the first miss. Lua: Player.rank <= 2 and product.code == c01.

name: matchBonus
note: Stored as vector with a 0 prepended: bonus[0]=0, bonus[i]=table[i]. Indexed by number of ingredients cleared; counts past the end use the last element. Absent table leaves the vector empty (then back() on an empty vector is undefined; Lua always supplies it for coffee categories).

name: countdowntime
note: default 3000

name: gametime
note: default 60000

name: warntime
note: default 8000; whistle sound when remaining time crosses it

name: productName
note: stored, not otherwise used by native code

name: productCode
note: stored, not otherwise used

name: recipe
note: every value converted with AsString into the ProductRecipe vector, in table traversal order

name: conveyorpath
note: TCurve control points; Lua beverage default {0,596},{115,455},{250,597},{283,540}. The curve END point is also the gun base and gun sprite position.

name: conveyorcount
note: ingredients visible on the belt; default 5; spacing = 1/count

name: conveyortime
note: default 1200; whole-path travel time. Decompiler dropped the call argument; flow inferred from the constructor signature

name: colorcount
note: default 1; passed to IngredientQueue; coffee never uses colours

name: productpath
note: TCurve for finished cases; start point is where a CoffeeProduct appears, end point is where box_open sprites sit

name: producttime
note: default 3000; time for one case to travel the path

name: productspacing
note: default 1000; divided by producttime in the task constructor to give a path fraction

name: appearance
note: icons for cases (scale 0.5) and the box_open sprite

name: top_hood
note: position of image/conveyor_base_mask_upper (layer 7)

name: bottom_hood
note: position of image/conveyor_base_mask_lower (layer 7)

name: speedup
note: default 1.1; grid scale multiplier per match. ui/coffee_factory.lua does NOT pass it, so category speedup (1.2 / 1.15) is never used

name: maxspeed
note: default 8; grid scale cap. Not passed by Lua

name: columns
note: default 9; Lua passes 6 or 8

name: rows
note: default 9; Lua passes 9

name: gridx
note: default 10; Lua 146 (6 col) or 103 (8 col)

name: gridy
note: default 10; Lua 15

name: griddx
note: default 50; Lua 45

name: griddy
note: default 50; Lua 45

name: gridspeed
note: default 3000; time for the belt to scroll one row at scale 1. Lua passes category 5000 or 6000 (or product override). Flow inferred from constructor signature

name: gunspeed
note: default 250; time a shot needs to travel 1000 px

name: missed
note: positions where missed ingredients are parked; the length is the miss limit (8 in Lua)

name: autoFillGunPos
note: parsed into a local and discarded; CoffeeRefillTask is not constructed. autoFillRate, autoFillCount and categoryName are never read

name: x,y,w,h and children
note: children looked up by name in PostChildrenInit: time (optional TText), countdown (TText), score (TText)

name: gPauseText
note: set via TScript::SetGlobalString before ui/game_pause.lua runs; the script reads it and clears it

name: ui/game_pause.lua
note: shows pause text and an OK button that calls ResumeGame

name: ui/chocolate_gameover.lua
note: calls GetScore, shows factory_gameover string, Try again = StartGame(), OK = CloseWindow(score)

name: DoModal('dev/dev_menu.lua')
note: run via TWindowManager::DoLuaString on Escape when key flag bit 0 is set

name: 1002 kSoundEvent
note: posted globally with name launch (gun) or chocolate_counted (case arrives); consumer maps name to a sound event (inferred)

name: 1003 kMissedIngredientEvent
note: sent to child FactoryGame of the top modal; handler MissedIngredient

name: 1004 kManufactureProductEvent / 1005 kProduceProductEvent
note: both add a case to the product queue; nothing in the coffee code sends them

name: 1006 kCountBonusProductEvent
note: bonusScore++ and score++; not sent by coffee code

name: 1007 kCountProductEvent
note: score++ per finished case

name: 1010 kCollectedIngredientEvent
note: one message per match; handler applies bonus, speedup, flying-to-hopper
